verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an immigration provider could reasonably offer a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier. The evidence shows only a service promise of 'straight talk on viability' and educational guides, such as the F-1-to-O-1 and founder O-1 articles. Neither is a free, structured, self-serve eligibility assessment tool on the site, so this is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
